Peacham's Definition Of "Dwelling, Multi-Family" Simply States "More Than Three Families," Which Is Taken to Include Buildings Housing 5+ Families. As In The Rd, Adus Become A Conditional Use In The Vd When "A New Accessory Structure [Is] Constructed After The Enactment Of These Zoning Regulations, Or An Increase In The Height Or Floor Area Of The Existing Dwelling [Occurs]"

Although The Wh District Does Modify Permissible Uses In Underlying Areas, The Zoning Code Provides No Dimensional Standards For Single-Family Development In The Overlay. I Am Guessing That Dimensional Standards Remain Unchanged In The Wh District And Thus All That Changes Is The Prohibition Of Other Uses.
